Choosing a plan that fits how you read

This page exists so a test can run the three-gate site assessment against something that is not empty. It has headings, paragraphs, a short list, a form and a few links, which is enough for the bot-detection probe to see a real document and for the demand model to find text to decode, controls to point at and choices to weigh.

Three plans

  • Reader: one site, weekly summaries, no setup.
  • Builder: five sites, daily summaries, a shared dashboard.
  • Team: unlimited sites, hourly summaries, per-member access.

Every plan can be cancelled from the account page at any time, and nothing is charged until the first summary is delivered.

Questions people ask

Can I change plans later?

Yes. Moving between plans takes effect on the next summary and the difference is prorated.

What happens to my data if I leave?

It is exported to you and then deleted within thirty days.
